messages:
maya: noticed ~120 prod snapshot objects with missing ServerSideEncryption tag during morning audit. bucket=prod-snapshots, prefix=2026-03-21.
jon: wtf, our uploader should never drop SSE. any deploys overnight?
deploy-bot: Deploy 2026-03-21T02:14:00Z by harry: infra/vault-key-rotation v2.1 merged.
encops-bot: alert: burst of PutObject without SSE detected 2026-03-21T02:15:03Z - 02:17:10Z (count=123). Threshold exceeded.
sre: can someone run head-object on a sample key and share headers?
maya: head-object sample: 
```
$ aws s3api head-object --bucket prod-snapshots --key snaps/2026-03-21/f9d7e1
{"ContentLength": 104857600, "Metadata": {"tenant":"42"}, "ServerSideEncryption": null}
```
jon: that ServerSideEncryption null is bad. check uploader logs for kms calls and agent behavior.
harry: the vault-key-rotation deploy rotated the CMK alias to a new key and updated key policy to restrict cross-account rewrap temporarily while we validated. i added a short hold to prevent external rewrapers.
sre: that sounds like it might block our archival rewraper service which runs with a cross-account role. if rewrap is blocked, uploader might fallback to SSE-C or plaintext depending on agent config.
maya: uploader log: 
```
2026-03-21T02:16:04Z ERROR archive-agent: kms rewrap failed: AccessDeniedException
2026-03-21T02:16:04Z ERROR archive-agent: fallback mode enabled -> uploading without SSE
```
jon: two issues: 1) key policy change blocked rewraps, 2) agent has fallback to unencrypted which is unacceptable in prod.
harry: the rotation was intended to be transparent; I scoped the key policy to remove a wildcard principal while verification was in progress. i didn't realize the rewrap role was cross-account.
encops-bot: gitops: PR 5999 merged by harry @ 02:14UTC altered kms key policy for alias/backup-cmk to remove "arn:aws:iam::999999999999:role/rewrap-service" until validation.
jon: mitigation plan:
- immediately revert key policy to allow rewrap service (hotfix)
- run integrity check to list objects uploaded without SSE and isolate them (object keys saved to ticket)
- perform server-side copy rewrap, prefer S3 CopyObject with SSE-KMS to avoid egress
- patch archive-agent to fail when encryption step fails in prod
- add pre-deploy gating checklist: if key policy changes, verify rewrap role still allowed or schedule maintenance window
maya: for bulk rewrap we should rate-limit to avoid KMS throttling. run two canaries first (~5 objects).
sre: agree. also add CloudTrail query to map PutObject events in the window and capture IAM principal + source IP.
jon: sample CloudTrail lookup: 
```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=PutObject --start-time 2026-03-21T02:14:00Z --end-time 2026-03-21T02:18:00Z
```
harry: opening hotfix PR to revert policy now. sorry team.
encops-bot: task created: ENCRYPTOPS-720 (hotfix: restore rewrap-role in CMK policy) assigned to harry.
maya: also: add a bucket-level object-lifecycle audit that flags PutObject without SSE for snapshot buckets and pushes to security-audit queue.
jon: long-term: we must remove silent fallback paths in agents, and ensure key-policy changes require an impact analysis step documented in gitops PR template.
sre: i'll schedule a SRE runbook update and add a KMS health dashboard (errors, AccessDenied, throttles).
harry: hotfix merged @ 02:33UTC. will restart rewrap-service to pick up role trust change.
maya: canary rewrap completed: 5 objects rewrapped successfully. queueing bulk copy job with concurrency=4 and kms-calls-per-sec limit.
jon: opened postmortem doc draft; incl timeline, root cause (key policy scoping + silent fallback), remediation, follow-ups. meeting at 16:00UTC for blameless review.
encops-bot: note: affected object count=123, affected tenants=3 (42, 84, 99). incidents tracker: INC-2026-54.
sre: closing loop: monitor for any additional PutObject without SSE for next 24h and alert ops if found.
maya: thanks all.
